data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 claims SRC_004 'abstracts' SRC_003's complement method, but the proposed relation is substantively a contrast of two independent counting strategies (direct count vs. complement-and-subtract) that happen to target the same quantity. Calling one an 'abstraction' of the other does not establish an inheritance or reduction link; per the covering principle, the abstraction would need to show that SRC_004's zero-presence case split is a generalization whose instances map onto the PIE over position-equality, but the target only gestures at 'lifts the abstraction' without naming the structural mapping that makes one a genuine abstraction of the other. The refutation clause reduces to a numerical check (648 vs 900-252), which again is an equality check, not an abstraction relation.
